name: Collections
description: Collections and smart collections for your library — virtual groupings independent of folder structure. Gather photos into named collections by right-click, drag-and-drop, or the B target-collection shortcut, and build rule-based smart collections (rating, flags, labels, keywords, dates, camera, lens, ISO and more) that update live as your library changes.
author: Anthony Reimche <anthonyreimche@gmail.com>
